multiplayer_envworker_pilot.hypothesis: One process per game avoids several expensive search games serialized on one engine worker. OS schedules processes over available CPU cores.
multiplayer_envworker_pilot.comparison_limit: Changing worker count also changes worker-derived RNG seeds, so workloads are similar rather than identical. Measure rollout counts and durations; no strength claim from throughput.

multiplayer_async_pilot.hypothesis: Advance ready games while other engine processes search, removing the per-step slowest-worker barrier. Policy stays frozen until every game in the batch completes.
tests: 20 real mixed-count complete games match synchronous pool exactly under deterministic teacher actions, including terminal vectors and total decision count
Delayed fake worker verifies no premature batch completion or dropped terminal records
multiplayer_async_pilot.comparison_limit: Same game seeds and opponent assignments as synchronous 240-worker pilot, but stochastic learner RNG is consumed in readiness order, so sampled trajectories can differ.
